title: Tanjiro — complete skill frame set
source: maplestory.io, GMS version 270 (skillbook API for jobs 12100; WZ API for 5th job skills and HEXA cores)

skills.name: Acclimation Training
skills.description: Standard Demon Slayer Corps training to enhance an individual's physical abilities.

skills.name: Total Concentration Breathing
skills.description:
A breathing technique that accelerates the user's blood circulation and heart rate, allowing a human to fight with the strength of a demon.\r
Increases the damage of Tanjiro's skills.

skills.name: Basic Fitness Training
skills.description: Lay the foundation of long-term fitness by mastering the basics.

skills.name: Enhanced Weapon Mastery
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed and weapon mastery.

skills.name: Basic Combat Training
skills.description: Train hard to become an expert Demon Slayer by mastering the basics.

skills.name: Intermediate Fitness Training
skills.description: Raise your fitness to the upper echelons of human ability with intermediate training techniques.

skills.name: Joint Training I
skills.description:
Train yourself to fight alongside your allies.\r
Increases the damage of Beast Breathing and Thunder Breathing skills.

skills.name: Intermediate Combat Training
skills.description: Advance to the skills of an expert swordsman, the basic standard for the rank of Mizunoto.

skills.name: Advanced Fitness Training
skills.description: Break through your human limits and gain the strength to combat demons.

skills.name: Constant Concentration
skills.description:
Keeps the Total Concentration Breathing technique continuously active, restoring a great deal of your power.\r
Enhances the damage of Water Breathing and Dancing Flash skills.

skills.name: Joint Training II
skills.description:
Work with your allies to become an unbeatable team.\r
Enhances the damage of Beast Breathing and Thunder Breathing skills.

skills.name: Advanced Combat Training
skills.description: Break through your human limits and wield a blade that demons fear.

skills.name: Body Temperature Spike
skills.description:
Temporarily increase your body temperature, allowing you to fight with explosive power.\r
Enhances the damage of Water Breathing and Dancing Flash skills.

skills.name: Basic Swordsmanship
skills.description: Move forward and attack with a basic sword technique. Hit the target up to 4 times.

skills.name: Battle Stance
skills.description:
Plant your feet in a battle stance that allows you to use the Basic Swordsmanship technique without moving, depending on the situation.\r
Using the skill activates the effect and it can be toggled On/Off.

skills.name: Vulpes Leap
skills.description:
Allows you to double jump.\r
Press the up key at the same time to move upward.

skills.name: High-Speed Movement
skills.description:
Quickly charge in the direction you are facing.\r
Move freely in all 8 directions with the arrow keys.
skills.note: effect (2 frames) is a blank timing sequence in the source WZ (1x1 frames); omitted.

skills.name: Warrior of the Corps
skills.description:
Temporarily increases the stats of all party members.\r
Stacks with Maple Warrior, Call of Cygnus, Nova Warrior, Hero of the Flora, President's Orders, Anima Warrior, Rhinne's Protection, Pink Warrior, and Hero of El Nath based on what was learned.

skills.name: Will of the Corps
skills.description: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to Abnormal Status for 3 sec after use. However, this will not work for all abnormal status effects.

skills.name: Water Breathing Second Form: Water Wheel
skills.description: Spin your body like water carried around a wheel and cut down your foes.

skills.name: Water Breathing Fourth Form: Striking Tide
skills.description:
Strike with the grace of a flowing tide and seal your opponent's movement.\r
Affected enemies cannot be stunned again by Water Breathing Fourth Form: Striking Tide or other skills for 90 seconds.
Not affected by cooldown reset.

skills.name: Beast Breathing Fifth Fang: Crazy Cutting
skills.description:
Call upon Inosuke to periodically fly through the air and attack in all directions.\r
Unaffected by attack reflection.
Can be toggled On/Off.
skills.note: effect (1 frames) is a blank timing sequence in the source WZ (1x1 frames); omitted.

skills.name: Beast Breathing Fifth Fang: Crazy Cutting
Water Breathing Sixth Form: Whirlpool
skills.description: Twist like an all-consuming whirlpool to attack with a slashing vortex.

skills.name: Thunder Breathing First Form: Thunderclap and Flash
skills.description:
Call upon Zenitsu to appear like a bolt of thunder and slash with lightning speed.\r
Unaffected by attack reflection and cooldown reset.
skills.note: effect (1 frames) is a blank timing sequence in the source WZ (1x1 frames); omitted.

skills.name: Water Breathing Eighth Form: Waterfall Basin
skills.description:
Strike downwards with the force of a roaring waterfall.\r
Hit enemies are weakened temporarily and have decreased defense.

skills.name: Hinokami Kagura: Dancing Flash
skills.description:
Launch an all-out attack that combines the powerful slash of Hinokami Kagura: Dance with the lightning dash of Thunder Breathing First Form: Thunderclap and Flash.\r
Unaffected by attack reflection and cooldown reset.
skills.note: effect (1 frames) is a blank timing sequence in the source WZ (1x1 frames); omitted.
